entities.name: Great Salt Marsh
entities.description: A vast wasteland in Golthonor in southeastern Corondor, with many conflicts in its history.

entities.name: Golthonor
entities.description: A desolate province of Corondor containing the Great Salt Marsh.

entities.name: Coldraith
entities.description: A wizard who blocked the Corthipan Inlet in 4196 AR and was later killed by Altair and Caliphear.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar the Swamp King
entities.description: Ruler who demanded tribute from Khone and Shikar and destroyed Shikar in the Dragon War.

entities.name: Altair
entities.description: Met Caliphear at the Corthipan Inlet and helped kill Coldraith.

entities.name: Caliphear
entities.description: Met Altair at the Corthipan Inlet and helped kill Coldraith.

entities.name: Khone
entities.description: The northeastern swamp, ruled nominally by the Lord of House Khone.

entities.name: Sulgh
entities.description: The southwestern swamp at the mouth of the Golthonor Torrent.

entities.name: Shikar
entities.description: A city destroyed by Sol'Kanar in the Dragon War.

entities.name: Corthipan Inlet
entities.description: Where the Golthonor Torrent enters the marsh.

entities.name: Golthonor Torrent
entities.description: The waterfall that feeds the Great Salt Marsh.

entities.name: Grenfell Mor
entities.description: The wizard seen as the visible symbol of oppression by the marsh's people.

events.summary: Sol'Kanar sides with treacherous Khone in the Dragon War and destroys the city of Shikar.
events.quote: Sol'Kanar took the side of treacherous Khone, and destroyed the city of Shikar

events.summary: In 4196 AR Coldraith blocks the Corthipan Inlet, draining the swamp and flooding the plains to the north.
events.quote: the wizard Coldraith blocked off the Corthipan Inlet

events.summary: Altair and Caliphear kill Coldraith and the water returns to the marshes.
events.quote: The water returned to the marshes after Coldraith was killed by Altair and Caliphear

relations.quote: Coldraith was killed by Altair and Caliphear
The Great Salt Marsh lies in Golthonor
